caption: Sh. 14. Stela (Areika, Pl. 36, No. 5114)
labels: sic, by line 8 (over the i of te-r-i-e-lowi, where k is missing)
reading: soreyi : wosi : (2)qore k?nyeqo(3)wi : nm?d?iyetd(4)ḫelowi : be[.][.][.][.] te(5)rikelowi : kei(6)yeqowi : alp?ye (7)tdḫelowi temey(8)yoe : terielow?i (9)atom?e : psom?i?b : (10)atomẖe : psiḫrb : (11)ate?tḫm?eole : pw?(12)tḫb : k? : troi? :
notes: Line 1 reads soreyi before wosi (right group is soreyi). '//3' groups read q+o (qore, qowi); the q vs o+s trap applies. Line 2: hatched sign with long tail after qore read k?, could be a. Line 3: '3' before the n could belong to n (R-shape) or be m; 'x' after it d or ñ; the two dots before the hook in td(4)ḫelowi taken as the dot of t, not a divider. Line 4: after ḫelowi a thick dash and ~3 signs of hatching read as four lost signs. Line 8: terielowi with Griffith's sic (k missing); w of lowi dotted. Line 9: atom?e has only one 3-shaped sign between to and e (line 10 has m and ẖ). Line 11: '/⊬' after a read te, could be t+o. Line 12 end: k? and troi? uncertain, last sign hatched.

caption: Sh. 18. Stela with male figure (Areika, Pl. 38, No. 5121)
notes: No line numbers and no dividers except gaps. Starts with 3+4 (si, as in the end of wosi) then e, y, i: perhaps a shortened invocation. Cup-shaped sign read ḫ? (could be se). N-shaped sign read d?. Last sign a ϟ-hook with a dot on its left read t?.

notes: Line 1: n is an R-shape with long tail under i and y. '/7' read m+o (pelmos parallel); in line 4 it is marked sic. Line 2 start: long-tailed sign p? then '/3' (s+o or q). Line 3: second w hatched. Line 4: first sign after pilmos a hook with a stroke (t?), then e, ·ϟ (t), ν (b), ʂ (l?). Line 5: ⇐-shaped sign read ḫ?. Line 6: hatched sign after wos read i?.
